formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (F : Finset ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → (∀ g ∈ F, g < C.gates.length) → ((F.biUnion (fun g => (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g).inputs.toFinset)).filter (fun w => w < n)).card + ((F.biUnion (fun g => (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g).inputs.toFinset)).filter (fun w => n ≤ w ∧ w - n ∉ F)).card + (F.filter (fun g => n + g ∈ F.biUnion (fun g' => (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C g').inputs.toFinset))).card ≤ 2 * F.card
plain_statement: C is a circuit of AND and OR gates on n inputs, each reading exactly two earlier wires, and F a set of its gates. Let R be the set of wires read by gates of F. Then (the inputs in R) plus (the gates outside F whose wires are in R) plus (the gates of F whose wires are in R) is at most twice the size of F.
title: Slot count: a set F of exact fan-in-two AND/OR gates reads at most 2|F| distinct wires (inputs, gates outside F, gates of F)
